meta.title: Reference values for the M4 commands (pipe_wall_check, resolve_joint, component_shape): committed oracles with their source and grade
meta.note: Every case says whether it is a published value (grade A/B, source id of sources.md) or a hand derivation (grade D = derived, recomputed here with the arithmetic shown). The tests read this file; they never copy the numbers.

wallB313.formula: ASME B31.3 304.1.2 eq. (3a): t = P D / (2 (S E W + P Y)); tm = t + c; required nominal = tm / (1 - mill tolerance); valid for t < D/6 and P/(S E) <= 0.385

published.source: S18 whatispiping.com worked example NPS 4, 1200 psig, S 19000 psi (recomputed with S19 formula and Y 0.4), grade A

derived.how: eq. (3a) solved for P gives the pressure a wall t carries: P = 2 S E W t / (D - 2 Y t). Feeding the wall back must return the design pressure within 1e-9 relative.
P/(S E) = 6/(138 x 1) = 0.0435 is thin, 60/(138 x 1) = 0.435 > 0.385 must be refused (B31.3 304.1.2(a)); the same pressure in psi (8702.26) must be refused too

t/D = r / (2 (W + r Y)) with r = P/(S E). For Y = 0 and W = 1, t/D reaches 1/6 at r = 1/3, below the 0.385 ratio limit, so r = 0.35 (t = 0.175 D) must be refused by the D/6 gate while the ratio gate still passes. For Y = 0.4 the two limits coincide near r = 0.385 (1/(3 - Y) = 0.3846).

stud.rule: L = ceil((t1 + RF1 + t2 + RF2 + g + 2 nut + 2 x 2 pitch) / 6.35) x 6.35 mm; nut = nominal bolt diameter; pitch 25.4/11 mm for 5/8 in UNC; B16.5 raised face 1.6 mm Class 150 / 300
stud.grade: D (derived: nut height, gasket thickness and projection are named assumptions; no published stud table is in the pack)

elbowLr90Nps6.source: VC-PSC-19: closed form from B16.9 A = 228.6 (S8, S9, S10) and B36.10M OD 168.3 (S1, S2)

elbowLr45Nps4.source: spec 5.8: B16.9 LR 45 NPS 4 tabulated B 63.5 (S8, S10) against R tan(22.5 deg) with R = 1.5 x 4 x 25.4 = 152.4; R tan(22.5 deg) = 63.1261 mm, so the straight end is 63.5 - 63.1261 = 0.3739 mm (the spec text rounds R tan to 63.13)
